import json,re
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
source=json.loads(Path('source.json').read_text())
answer=json.loads(Path('answer.json').read_text())
allowed=set('p br table thead tbody tfoot tr th td b strong i em u sup sub ul ol li div span blockquote'.split())
expected={'code_id','source_id','source_sha256','number','proposed_xml','reason','review_notes','status'}
assert len(answer)==len(source)==24

def text(e): return ' '.join(' '.join(e.itertext()).split())
def tables(root): return [[[text(c) for c in tr] for tr in t.findall('.//tr')] for t in root.findall('table')]
for old,new in zip(source,answer):
 assert set(new)==expected
 for k in ('code_id','source_id','source_sha256','number'): assert new[k]==old[k]
 assert new['status']=='rewrite_draft' and new['proposed_xml']
 a=ET.fromstring('<root>'+old['source_xml']+'</root>')
 b=ET.fromstring('<root>'+new['proposed_xml']+'</root>')
 for e in b.iter():
  if e is b: continue
  assert e.tag in allowed
  assert all(k in ('rowspan','colspan') and re.fullmatch('[0-9]+',v) for k,v in e.attrib.items())
 assert tables(a)==tables(b)
 nums=lambda e: Counter(re.findall(r'\\b\\d+(?:[.,]\\d+)?(?:-\\d+)*\\b',text(e)))
 assert nums(a)==nums(b),(new['number'],nums(a)-nums(b),nums(b)-nums(a))
 assert text(a)"'!=text(b)
 if old.get('"'source_notes_xml'):

  assert not note_nums-review_nums,(new['number'],'données de note manquantes',note_nums-review_nums)
 assert Path('fragments',new['number']+'.xml').read_text().strip()==new['proposed_xml']
 report.append({'number':new['number'],'status':'rewrite_draft','identifiers_match':True,'numeric_tokens_preserved':True,'tables_preserved':True,'source_notes_accounted_for':True})
for number in ('L1234-17','L1235-2','L1235-3-2','L1235-8','L1235-11'):
 x=next(x for x in answer if x['number']==number)
 print(number,x['proposed_xml'])
